faq.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most often. Have another one? Reach out — we reply fast.

items.a: Every project is priced in writing before it starts. No surprises along the way. [RANGE TO CONFIRM]

items.q: How much of my time will it take?
items.a: As little as possible. A few short meetings, by phone if you prefer — we handle the rest, copy included.

items.q: I have no copy, photos, or logo.
items.a: That’s expected. Writing is part of the job, and we guide you on visuals. You’re never “not ready”.

items.q: I already have a website, but it’s weak. Do you rebuild it?
items.a: Yes. Most of our clients start from an outdated or unconvincing site. We rebuild on a solid foundation, with a far more professional and effective result.

items.q: Will the site be in both French and English?
items.a: Yes, fully bilingual from the start. Every page exists in both languages, built for your French- and English-speaking customers alike.

items.q: How will my customers reach me or book a meeting?
items.a: Contact form, online booking, and quick access via WhatsApp. The goal is simple: let a customer reach you in a single tap.

items.q: Will I be able to manage my blog myself?
items.a: Yes. The blog is self-managed: you publish and edit your articles whenever you want, without depending on us.

items.q: Will the site rank well on Google?
items.a: SEO is planned from the start: structure, metadata, and content built for Google. It’s an ongoing effort over time, not a checkbox.

final.subtitle: One call is enough to know whether we can help. No pressure, no jargon.
